verdict_reason: The new INS @active section matches the two security specs, with one minor imprecision about which steps are addressId routes.

todos.issue: docs/security.md:74 says address-book.spec.ts 'adds, views, edits and deletes one address. Each of those is an /address-book/{addressId} route'. Adding is not: the spec adds through insJourney.addAddressFromList (tests/ins/security/address-book/address-book.spec.ts:14), which drives /address-book/add, and only view, edit and delete open addressBookView/Edit/Delete.open(id).
todos.fix: Must: the bullet says which of the spec's steps are /address-book/{addressId} routes (view, edit, delete) and does not claim add is one. One way: 'adds one address, then views, edits and deletes it; those three are /address-book/{addressId} routes, and the addressId dataDrivenNode has nothing to fold without them.'
